description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
SOFTWARE ENGINEER, CONSUMER SUBSCRIPTIONS
As an engineer for Consumer Subscriptions (X Premium, SuperGrok, Cursor), you will play a key role in the entire billing and monetization infrastructure powering one of SpaceXSI's fastest-growing revenue organizations. You will be part of a dedicated engineering team responsible for growth, commerce infra, subscriptions, promotions, global payments, and personalized user experiences at massive scale. This high-impact engineering role offers the opportunity to directly drive significant revenue growth while architecting systems that serve hundreds of millions of users worldwide and shape the future of premium AI and social products.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Build the complete billing infrastructure for consumer subscriptions end-to-end, ensuring world-class reliability, security, and scalability
Design and build sophisticated promotional offer infrastructure and internal tools to supercharge the revenue organization
Develop comprehensive communications systems enabling intelligent push, email, and in-app messaging that drive engagement and conversions
Implement market-specific billing methods and compliance solutions to accelerate global expansion
Architect compelling product bundles across the X ecosystem tailored to different markets and consumer needs
Build intelligent models and systems that serve the right messages, offers, and information to users at the optimal time
Hands-on ownership and development of key features for X Premium and SuperGrok products
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
2+ years of experience with backend systems for consumer applications
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Exceptional software engineering background with deep experience building large-scale, high-stakes systems (billing, payments, or transactional platforms preferred)
Proven ability to lead technical initiatives and influence or directly manage engineering teams
Strong track record delivering complex backend systems for consumer applications at scale
Passion for revenue-generating products and creating exceptional user experiences
5+ years of experience working on large-scale consumer applications, ideally in monetization, subscriptions, or fintech
Experience leading engineering efforts in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Expertise in distributed systems, global payments infrastructure, personalization engines, or A/B testing frameworks
Proficiency with high-performance languages and tools such as Go, Python, Java, Rust, or similar
COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
$140,000 - $225,000 USD
Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.
